keyVerseDR: "Every one therefore that heareth these my words, and doth them, shall be likened to a wise man that built his house upon a rock." (Mt 7:24)

level1.title: House on the Rock
level1.story: Jesus told a story about two houses. The wise man built on rock, and his house stood strong in the storm. The foolish man built on sand, and it fell.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What happened to the house on sand?
How can you build on Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are my Rock. Amen.

activity.title: House on the rock
activity.intro: Draw the other half of the house built on rock.

level2.title: The Wise and Foolish Builders
level2.story: Jesus said that not everyone who says "Lord, Lord" will enter the kingdom, but only those who do the Father's will. "Everyone who listens to My words and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on rock," He said. The rain fell, the floods came, and the winds blew, but the house did not fall. Whoever hears His words and does not act on them is like a fool who built on sand. When the storm came, that house collapsed completely.
level2.keyLine: A wise man that built his house upon a rock.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why is doing God's word more than just hearing it?
actions: Put one Gospel teaching into action
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me build my life on You. Amen.
